A very challanging game at the beginning, but it´s fair and the gameplay is just perfect.

Oh and after some time I even realised the amount of lore and detail put in there, to such a degree that I decided to make a Video about the Lore.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wqwu95lWy6s

Risk of Rain is an enjoyable platformer which offers familiar yet fun gameplay in a platformer. The goal of the game is to find the teleporter in each floor, survive and move to the next level. It features a colourful cast of characters to play from, each offering their own skills and perks which change gameplay according to each character. Each level has 2-3 variants in its type and offers some variety in the levels but limited.

The game offers a huge variety of items to be picked up in the game with varying effects and boons. The game's difficulty increases with the time spent on each run as well the fun of the game. When I first started the game, I found the game extremely difficult and the bosses if not familiar can rip you apart. However, once you get better in the game, the game becomes a joy to play especially when overloading runs (Going back to the first level before the final level with all items intact as well as difficulty). 

The game gives some more variety in its gameplay as well through the use of unlockables called artifacts and different artifacts can alter the gameplay slightly to drastically. This game also offers online multiplayer so going online with your friends and playing with them adds to the fun in the game. Just join in a game altogether, skype between all of your and you will have a blast.

Overall, this game is a great platformer with its familiar yet fun gameplay. It has unique gameplay elements and enemies that give the game its enjoyment and with friends it is even more fun. I recommend this game if you're looking for a classic level platformer with unique twists.

One of the best Rouge-Like's I have played, and definitley the one I have played the most. Very simple controls, but the game itself is very difficult but even if hard games aren't generally your cup of tea, I still highly reccomend this game.
This is a fun game to play when you need to kill time and you don't want to get invested in a story

The game is fun. It has many secrets and unlockables. It has many characters that you can play with. It as a variety of bosses and levels. It has many types of items that do many types of things. RoR also has dance clubs and secret doors. The final boss is engaging, while not being too difficult if you know what to expect from him.
Overall this game deserves 10.5/10
